glossary.arpuDesc: Average revenue generated per user in a period. Fundamental for revenue projections.
glossary.b2bDesc: Model where you sell to other companies. Longer sales cycles, larger tickets.
glossary.b2cDesc: Model where you sell directly to consumers. Higher volumes, smaller tickets.
glossary.burnRateDesc: How much money the startup spends per month. Gross burn is total, net burn is costs minus revenue.
glossary.cacDesc: Total marketing and sales cost divided by number of new customers. Lower is better.
glossary.capTableDesc: Table showing who owns what percentage of the company and what type of shares.
glossary.churnRateDesc: Percentage of customers who cancel per month. 5% churn means losing half your customers in ~14 months.
glossary.cliffDesc: Initial vesting period where no shares are earned. Protects the company if someone leaves early.
glossary.dilutionDesc: Reduction in ownership percentage when new shares are issued. Normal in each round.
glossary.grossMarginDesc: Revenue minus direct cost of delivering product/service. For SaaS, typically 70-90%.
glossary.ltvCacRatioDesc: Indicates growth efficiency. Above 3:1 is healthy. Below 1:1 means losing money.
glossary.ltvDesc: Total expected revenue from a customer over the entire relationship. Should be at least 3x CAC.
glossary.mrrDesc: Predictable, recurring revenue generated monthly. Foundation for evaluating SaaS growth.
glossary.mvpDesc: Simplified product version with essential features sufficient to validate hypotheses with early adopters.
glossary.npsDesc: Measures customer loyalty by asking 'would you recommend?'. Scale -100 to +100. Above 50 is excellent.
glossary.paybackPeriodDesc: Time needed to recover CAC. Ideally less than 12 months.
glossary.pmfDesc: When the product satisfies a strong market need. Indicators: organic growth, low churn, high NPS.
glossary.preemptionDesc: Right of existing investors to participate in future rounds on the same terms.
glossary.runwayDesc: Months of operation remaining with current cash. Calculate: cash balance ÷ monthly burn rate.
glossary.saasDesc: Subscription software model, hosted in the cloud. Recurring and scalable revenue.
glossary.samDesc: Part of TAM you can realistically reach with current business model.
glossary.somDesc: Part of SAM you can capture short-term, considering competition and resources.
glossary.subtitle: Essential concepts for founders
glossary.tamDesc: Total revenue if you captured 100% of the market. Shows maximum potential.
glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.unitEconomicsDesc: Metrics that show profitability per customer or product unit. Includes CAC, LTV, and gross margin.
glossary.vestingDesc: Period during which shares are 'earned' gradually. Typically 4 years with 1-year cliff.

unitEconomics.description: Calculate your key SaaS metrics: CAC, LTV, LTV/CAC ratio, and payback period
unitEconomics.grossMarginTooltip: Revenue minus cost of goods sold (typically 70-90% for SaaS)
unitEconomics.ltvCacExplanation: Should be ≥3x for a healthy business. Below 1x means you're losing money per customer.
unitEconomics.ltvExplanation: Total value a customer generates over their lifetime. The higher, the better.
unitEconomics.marketingCostsTooltip: Total monthly spend on marketing: ads, content, events, etc.
unitEconomics.monthlyChurnRateTooltip: Percentage of customers who cancel each month
unitEconomics.newCustomersTooltip: Number of new paying customers acquired this month
unitEconomics.paybackExplanation: Months to recover CAC. Ideally ≤12 months for early-stage startups.
unitEconomics.salesCostsTooltip: Total monthly sales costs: salaries, commissions, tools
unitEconomics.tip1: 5%/month churn means losing half your customers in ~14 months
unitEconomics.tip2: Typical gross margin for SaaS is 70-90%
unitEconomics.tip3: Focus on reducing CAC or increasing LTV before scaling
